cortex.inputSignature: User request plus manifest routing matrix, available tools, memory context, and prior agent state.
cortex.outputSignature: Intent classification, selectedToolID or target slot, approval requirement, and concise routing summary.

embedding.purpose: Perform the embedding role defined by the Lumen model fleet contract.
embedding.inputSignature: Role-specific input defined by the fleet contract and AgentBehaviorManifest.
embedding.outputSignature: Role-specific output defined by the fleet contract and AgentBehaviorManifest.

executor.inputSignature: Approved Cortex plan, exact tool ID, argument candidates, permission state, and approval state.
executor.outputSignature: Strict JSON tool call, clarification request, approval request, or structured tool result.

mimicry.inputSignature: Draft response, user style hints, locale, tone preferences, and safety constraints.
mimicry.outputSignature: Style-adjusted user-facing text or style profile that preserves facts and safety boundaries.

mouth.inputSignature: Tool result, user-visible state, style profile, and safety/sentinel constraints.
mouth.outputSignature: Final user-facing text with no private reasoning, raw tool JSON, or forbidden sentinels.

rem.inputSignature: Audit failure, conversation summary, memory candidates, freshness policy, and manifest context.
rem.outputSignature: Repair sample, memory decision, freshness classification, or runtime drift recommendation.

tools.description: Add an event to your calendar. Args: title, startsInMinutes.
Read upcoming calendar events. Args: none.
Create a new reminder. Args: title.
Read pending reminders. Args: none.
Find a contact by name. Args: query. Only use for the user's address book, not web people search.
Compose an iMessage/SMS draft. Args: to, body, optional recipient/number/message/text.
Compose an email draft using the system mail composer. Args: to, subject, body, optional recipient/email/message/text.
Check whether the Microsoft Graph Outlook account is signed in. Args: none.
List Outlook/Hotmail mail folders with unread and total counts. Args: optional includeHidden true/false.
List recent Outlook messages. Args: optional folder or folderId, limit, unreadOnly.
Search Outlook mail with Microsoft Graph. Args: query, optional folder/folderId, limit.
Read one Outlook message body by id. Args: messageId, optional id.
List attachment metadata for one Outlook message. Args: messageId, optional id.
Create a saved Outlook draft through Microsoft Graph. Args: to, subject, body.
Send an Outlook email through Microsoft Graph. Args: to, subject, body. Requires explicit approval.
Mark an Outlook message as read. Args: messageId, optional id. Requires explicit approval.
Mark an Outlook message as unread. Args: messageId, optional id. Requires explicit approval.
Move an Outlook message to a folder. Args: messageId, destination, optional id/destinationId. Requires explicit approval.
Move an Outlook message to Archive. Args: messageId, optional id. Requires explicit approval.
Delete an Outlook message. Args: messageId, optional id. Requires explicit approval.
Reply to an Outlook message. Args: messageId, body, optional id/comment. Requires explicit approval.
Reply-all to an Outlook message. Args: messageId, body, optional id/comment. Requires explicit approval.
Forward an Outlook message. Args: messageId, to, optional id/body/comment. Requires explicit approval.
Open the phone dialer for a number. Args: number. Never use for general lookup.
Get the user's current GPS location. Args: none. Use before nearby/local map searches when location context is needed.
Get current weather using GPS or a city. Args: optional location or city. Use when the user asks weather, temperature, rain, snow, wind, forecast now, or conditions.
Open Apple Maps directions to a real destination. Args: destination. Use only for navigation/route requests.

Find nearby/local places in Apple Maps. Args: query. Use only for local places like coffee near me, pharmacy nearby, closest hardware store, addresses, or directions. Do not use for DIY, tutorials, research, articles, or general web search.
Search the user's photo library by date/category terms. Args: query. Not for web image search.
Take a photo with the device camera. Args: none.
Read steps, sleep, heart rate, energy, and distance. Args: none.
Detect recent device motion activity such as walking/running. Args: none.

Search the web for general knowledge, fresh information, tutorials, DIY guides, plans, research, articles, or documentation. Args: query. Use this for `search for ...` unless the user explicitly wants nearby/local places.
Fetch and read a specific web page. Args: url. Use only when the user gives a URL or a prior web search returns one to inspect.
Read a previously imported local document by name. Args: name. Do not use for attached files already visible in the current prompt.
Store a user fact or preference for future recall. Args: content, kind.
Search stored memories about the user. Args: query. Not for web search.
Semantic search across indexed local files, PDFs, notes, and photo metadata. Args: query, optional limit. Not for internet search.
Rebuild the index for imported files and PDFs. Args: none.
Rebuild the monthly photo metadata index. Args: months.
Schedule a background agent run. Args: title, prompt, schedule, optional inMinutes/atTime/intervalSeconds/beforeMinutes.
Show active scheduled agent runs. Args: none.
Cancel a scheduled agent run. Args: id, optional title.
Check AlarmKit authorization state. Args: none.
Request permission to use AlarmKit alarms. Args: none.
Schedule an AlarmKit alarm. Args: title, inMinutes, optional timestamp/repeats/snoozeMinutes.
Create a countdown alarm. Args: title, durationSeconds.
List active AlarmKit alarms. Args: none.
Pause an alarm. Args: id UUID.
Resume a paused alarm. Args: id UUID.
Stop an alerting alarm. Args: id UUID.
Snooze an alerting alarm. Args: id UUID.
Cancel a scheduled alarm. Args: id UUID.
